sectors.trend: Gold leads with best monthly gain since February; WA gold exploration (Great Southern, Kaiser) and rare earths (Lindian, Barkly NT 99% magnet extraction) show strong pipeline. Iron ore sentiment weak ('iron ore roaches seeth'). Phosphate revival via Aguia. Uranium exploration (Infini) active.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX, STO.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, AUR.AX) offer relative strength. Iron ore exposure (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) faces headwinds from weak demand signals. Uranium (NCI.AX, SU3.AX) benefits from exploration momentum.

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations pressure bank NIMs but support deposit pricing. Property investor credit crash post-budget tax changes raises NPL concerns for property-linked lending. Macquarie (MQG.AX) $700m KPMG audit bid signals M&A activity. ASIC flags insurer cash-settlement shortfalls.
sectors.implications: Big Four banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face mixed NIM vs credit-risk dynamics. Property lenders and REITs under pressure. Insurers (CGF.AX, WBC.AX) face regulatory scrutiny on claim settlements.

sectors.trend: Oil spikes on US-Iran strikes at Strait of Hormuz; Goldman Sachs issues blunt oil/economy warning. Wind farm drought addressed by Danish entrant. One Nation pushes coal and nuclear in Victoria. Gas reservation policy under political attack.
sectors.implications: Oil & gas producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX, GWO.AX) benefit from oil spike but face geopolitical volatility. Renewables (SOL.AX, LNC.AX) get policy tailwind from wind farm investment. Coal (BRL.AX) faces political headwind. LNG (GWO.AX, WDS.AX) supported by Hormuz risk premium.

sectors.trend: Sharp deterioration: home values decline in August, buyer activity 'particularly low', auction sentiment weak, property investor credit growth crashes. Bathla (developer) warns of potential collapse. Some renter respite noted.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) and property developers face significant downside. Mortgage brokers and construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) exposed. Rate-sensitive sectors under pressure from rising RBA expectations.

sectors.trend: Woolworths to stop Tassie beef sales, testing supply chains. August data shows strong weight-loss drug demand, 'dupe' brand preference, and accelerating EV uptake. Qantas strike vote threatens air travel.
sectors.implications: WES.AX and WOW.AX face supply-chain and margin pressure. CSL.AX and healthcare benefit from weight-loss drug demand. QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk. EV uptake supports long-term energy transition plays.

sectors.trend: Australia flagged as slow AI adopter, risking economic boom participation. SpaceX exploring AI data centre disruption. Meta $24b settlement influenced by Australia's social media ban.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX, ASX.AX) face productivity gap risk. AI infrastructure and data centre plays gain global attention. Australia's regulatory stance on social media provides policy leverage.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from Middle East geopolitical risk, property sector weakness, and rising rate expectations. Oil-driven energy outperformance offsets broad market softness. Qantas strike and Star Entertainment issues add idiosyncratic risk. Expect choppy, risk-off tone into September.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural concerns around property credit contraction and AI adoption gap weigh on medium-term growth. Gold, rare earths, and energy transition offer relative strength. RBA policy path and US fiscal/debt dynamics ($40T) will dominate global risk appetite. Australian equity market likely to underperform global indices unless property stabilises.
